name: Miyagawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miyagawa village emblem in green: an outlined ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former village of Miyagawa in Gifu Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-02-01.

features.role: Miyagawa village emblem — an outlined ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised character
